map.三、骨龄与生长数据: III. Bone age and growth data
map.颅面特征（额突/鞍鼻/小下颌）: Craniofacial features (frontal bossing, saddle nose, small mandible)
map.骨龄延迟>2岁: Bone age delayed by over 2 years
map.男孩靶身高 = (父亲身高 + 母亲身高 + 13) / 2 ± 5cm\n女孩:
Target height for boys = (father's height + mother's height + 13) / 2 ± 5cm
Target height for girls = (father's height + mother's height - 13) / 2 ± 5cm

±5cm is the range of genetic variation (3rd-97th percentile)
map.靶身高反映遗传潜力。若实际身高低于靶身高范围下限，提示存在病理因素（如GHD、: Target height reflects genetic potential. If actual height falls below the lower bound of the target height range, a pathological factor is suggested (GHD, Turner syndrome, chronic disease and so on). A deviation within ±5cm of the target height range is normal genetic variation.
map.靶身高偏矮不一定异常，但需结合SDS评估。若父母均矮（靶身高本身就低），子代矮小: A short target height is not automatically abnormal, but it must be read together with the SDS. If both parents are short (so the target height is itself low), short stature in the child may be familial or constitutional rather than pathological GHD.
map.数据来源：《中国0-18岁儿童青少年身高体重的标准化生长曲线》(2009) 简化: Source: standardised growth curves for height and weight of Chinese children and adolescents aged 0-18 (2009), simplified
map.SDS = (实际身高 - 同年龄同性别均值) / 标准差\n\nSDS ≤ -:
SDS = (actual height - mean for the same age and sex) / standard deviation

SDS ≤ -2 defines short stature (height below the 3rd percentile for the same age and sex)
map.Bayley-Pinneau法基于骨龄与实际年龄关系，预测成年终身高。分三种情况: The Bayley-Pinneau method uses the relationship between bone age and actual age to predict final adult height. It falls into three cases:
map.情况1：骨龄 ≈ 实际年龄（差值 ≤ 1岁）\n 预测身高 = 当前身高 ×:
Case 1: bone age ≈ actual age (difference ≤ 1 year)
  predicted height = current height × B/P coefficient
  (B is the median bone-age height percentile for that bone age, P is the final height coefficient)

Case 2: bone age > actual age (early type)
  predicted height comes out short (less growth remaining)

Case 3: bone age < actual age (delayed type, common in GHD)
  predicted height comes out tall (more growth remaining)
map.本工具采用简化系数法估算：当骨龄延迟时给予较高的终身高系数，骨龄提前时给予较低系: This tool uses a simplified coefficient method: a higher final height coefficient is applied when bone age is delayed and a lower one when it is early.
map.2岁后至青春期前，若年生长速度<4cm/年，需高度警惕生长障碍，建议内分泌科就诊: After age 2 up to pre-puberty, a yearly growth velocity under 4cm calls for a high alert for a growth disorder; an endocrinology visit is advised.
map.生长激素缺乏症(GHD)诊断要点: Key points for diagnosing growth hormone deficiency (GHD)
map.1. 身高低于同年龄同性别2SD（SDS ≤ -2）: 1. Height more than 2SD below the same age and sex (SDS ≤ -2)
map.2. 年生长速度 < 同年龄正常值（2岁后<4cm/年）: 2. Yearly growth velocity below the normal value for the age (under 4cm/year after age 2)
map.3. 骨龄延迟（通常 > 2岁）: 3. Delayed bone age (usually more than 2 years)
map.4. 两项GH激发试验峰值均 < 10 ng/mL: 4. Peak GH below 10 ng/mL on two stimulation tests
map.5. 排除其他导致矮小的疾病: 5. Other causes of short stature have been excluded
map.• 新生儿低血糖/黄疸延长/小阴茎: • Neonatal hypoglycaemia, prolonged jaundice or micropenis
map.• 颅面中线畸形（唇腭裂、独眼畸形等）: • Midline craniofacial malformation (cleft lip/palate, cyclopia and so on)
map.• 垂体MRI异常（垂体发育不良/异位后叶）: • Pituitary MRI abnormality (hypoplastic pituitary or ectopic posterior lobe)
map.• 多种垂体激素联合缺乏: • Combined deficiency of several pituitary hormones
map.• 皮下注射，每日睡前: • Subcutaneous injection, at bedtime each day
map.• 治疗第一年身高追赶最快（\"追赶生长\"）: • Height catch-up is fastest in the first year ("catch-up growth")
map.• 治疗需持续至达到可接受身高或骨骺闭合: • Treatment continues until an acceptable height is reached or the epiphyses close
map.• 需定期监测：甲状腺功能、IGF-1、血糖、骨龄: • Regular monitoring needed: thyroid function, IGF-1, blood glucose, bone age
map.⚠️ 本工具仅供参考，不能替代医疗诊断。矮小症诊断和GHD评估需由儿童内分泌专科: ⚠️ This tool is for reference only and does not replace medical diagnosis. Short stature diagnosis and GHD assessment need a paediatric endocrinologist weighing the full history, physical examination and laboratory results together. rhGH prescriptions must be issued by a specialist.

map.父亲 175 cm、母亲 162 cm、男孩：靶身高=(175+162+13)/: Father 175 cm, mother 162 cm, boy: target height=(175+162+13)/2=175 cm, giving a genetic range of about 170-180 cm. If actual height is clearly below that range and growth velocity has slowed, bone age and endocrine causes need assessment.
map.靶身高公式的局限？: What are the limits of the target height formula?
map.反映遗传潜力（约±2 SD，5 cm 内），受种族、营养、疾病影响；骨龄提前或落: It reflects genetic potential (about ±2 SD, within 5 cm) and is affected by ethnicity, nutrition and illness; an early or delayed bone age changes the final height, so a bone age film is needed too.
map.何时需要做激发试验？: When is a stimulation test needed?
map.身高低于靶身高范围且年生长速度异常（如<4–5 cm/年）、疑生长激素缺乏或慢性: When height is below the target height range and yearly growth velocity is abnormal (such as under 4-5 cm/year), or when growth hormone deficiency or chronic disease is suspected, a paediatric endocrinologist assesses the need.
